rules.quote: private static float getStressMultiplierForSpeed(float speed) { return Math.abs(speed); }
rules.topic: Network stress accounting: every member's actual stress = its impact value x |its RPM|; every source's actual capacity = its capacity value x |its generated RPM|; network totals are the sums

value.formula_capacity: sum over sources of capacity x abs(generated_rpm)
value.formula_stress: sum over members of impact x abs(rpm)

rules.topic: Over-stress condition and effect: when network stress exceeds network capacity, every block entity in the network is flagged overStressed and its speed drops to 0 (the whole network stalls, it does not slow down)

rules.quote: public final ConfigInt maxRotationSpeed = i(256, 64, "maxRotationSpeed", Comments.rpm, Comments.maxRotationSpeed);
rules.topic: Maximum rotation speed of any kinetic block, in RPM (config default; server config kinetics.maxRotationSpeed, range starts at 64)

Per-block stress impact and capacity values are code-registered defaults that become server config entries (stressValues config); live servers may override any block's value, so treat quoted per-block numbers as defaults
Water wheel generator: capacity value 32 SU per RPM, generated speed up to 8 RPM scaled by water flow score, so maximum output = 256 SU
Large water wheel generator: capacity value 128 SU per RPM, generated speed up to 4 RPM, so maximum output = 512 SU (double the small wheel at half the speed)
Windmill bearing generator: RPM = clamp(sail blocks / windmillSailsPerRPM (config default 8), 1, 16); capacity value 512 SU per RPM, so maximum output = 512 x 16 = 8192 SU at 128 or more sail blocks

rules.quote: public float getGeneratedSpeed() { return getCombinedCapacity() > 0 ? movementDirection * 16 * getSpeedModifier() : 0; }
rules.topic: Steam engine: base capacity value 1024 SU per RPM at efficiency 1.0; shaft speed = 16 RPM x speed modifier (1-4 from efficiency), capacity provided = efficiency x 1024 / modifier, so total output = efficiency x 16384 SU, max 16384 SU per engine

rules.quote: public int getMaxHeatLevelForBoilerSize(int boilerSize) { return (int) Math.min(18, boilerSize / 4); }
rules.topic: Boiler heat level cap from size: max heat level = min(18, boilerSize / 4), where boilerSize is the number of fluid tank blocks in the boiler; 4 tank blocks per heat level, hard cap 18

Boiler engine efficiency: actualHeat = min(activeHeat, water-supply cap, size cap); efficiency = 1.0 when attached engines <= actualHeat, else actualHeat / attachedEngines; a passive boiler (campfire/lava heat) gives efficiency (1/8) / attachedEngines; water supply cap = 1 heat level per 10 units of water supply rate
Fluid tank capacity: config fluidTankCapacity (default 8) x 1000 mB per tank block, so 8000 mB per block by default; a multiblock tank's capacity scales with its total block count

rules.quote: public final ConfigInt maxBeltLength = i(20, 5, "maxBeltLength", Comments.maxBeltLength);
rules.topic: Belt maximum length in blocks (config default; kinetics.maxBeltLength)

rules.quote: public enum HeatLevel implements StringRepresentable { NONE, SMOULDERING, FADING, KINDLED, SEETHING, ;
rules.topic: Blaze burner heat levels are the enum NONE, SMOULDERING, FADING, KINDLED, SEETHING (ascending); basin recipe heat requirements (none / heated / superheated in recipe data) are tested against this ladder with isAtLeast
